description: Expand operator-dashboard navigation from current 6 routes (Dashboard, Fleet, Drivers, Earnings, Reports, Settings) to comprehensive 10-section sidebar matching industry operations console standards: Live Overview, Dispatch, Live Map, Active Trips, Drivers, Incidents, Cancellations, Demand & Supply, Support Queue, Service Alerts. Currently has Dashboard/Fleet/Drivers/Earnings/Reports/Settings. Operator dashboard focuses on real-time operations management for fleet operators. All new pages will be scaffolds with proper layout and placeholder content.
steps: Read apps/operator-dashboard/src/App.tsx and apps/operator-dashboard/src/components/Sidebar.tsx to understand current routing and navigation structure

Update apps/operator-dashboard/src/components/Sidebar.tsx navItems array to include 10 items with appropriate Lucide icons: Live Overview (LayoutDashboard, /), Dispatch (Radio, /dispatch), Live Map (Map, /live-map), Active Trips (Navigation, /active-trips), Drivers (Users, /drivers), Incidents (AlertTriangle, /incidents), Cancellations (XCircle, /cancellations), Demand & Supply (TrendingUp, /demand-supply), Support Queue (MessageSquare, /support-queue), Service Alerts (Bell, /service-alerts). Keep Settings and Reports accessible from footer or separate section
Rename existing 'Dashboard' to 'Live Overview' in Sidebar.tsx and update labelKey to 'nav_live_overview'

Create apps/operator-dashboard/src/pages/Dispatch.tsx - scaffold page with title 'Dispatch Center', subtitle 'Manual trip assignment and driver coordination', sections: Available Drivers list, Pending Requests queue, Manual Assignment form, Dispatch History

Create apps/operator-dashboard/src/pages/LiveMap.tsx - scaffold page with title 'Live Map', subtitle 'Real-time fleet tracking', and placeholder for map component using react-leaflet (already in package.json): render Leaflet map centered on Dar es Salaam (-6.7924, 39.2083), add placeholder markers for drivers, include filter controls (All/Available/On-Trip)

Create apps/operator-dashboard/src/pages/ActiveTrips.tsx - scaffold page with title 'Active Trips', subtitle 'Ongoing trips in real-time', table columns: Trip ID, Driver, Passenger, Pickup, Destination, Status, ETA, Actions. Status filter (Accepted/Driver Arriving/In Progress)

Create apps/operator-dashboard/src/pages/Incidents.tsx - scaffold page with title 'Incidents', subtitle 'Safety incidents and reports', table columns: Incident ID, Trip ID, Driver, Passenger, Type, Severity, Status, Reported, Actions. Include severity badges (Critical/High/Medium/Low)

Create apps/operator-dashboard/src/pages/Cancellations.tsx - scaffold page with title 'Cancellations', subtitle 'Cancelled trips analysis', table columns: Trip ID, Driver, Passenger, Cancelled By, Reason, Time, Fare Lost. Include analytics: cancellation rate graph, top cancellation reasons

Create apps/operator-dashboard/src/pages/DemandSupply.tsx - scaffold page with title 'Demand & Supply', subtitle 'Fleet capacity planning', sections: Demand Heatmap (map placeholder), Supply vs Demand chart (Recharts line chart placeholder, Recharts already in package.json), Driver Availability by Hour, High Demand Zones table

Create apps/operator-dashboard/src/pages/SupportQueue.tsx - scaffold page with title 'Support Queue', subtitle 'Operator support tickets', table columns: Ticket ID, Requester (Driver/Passenger), Subject, Priority, Status, Created, Assigned To, Actions. Include status filter (Open/In Progress/Resolved)

Create apps/operator-dashboard/src/pages/ServiceAlerts.tsx - scaffold page with title 'Service Alerts', subtitle 'System notifications and broadcasts', form to create new alert, list of active/past alerts with: Alert Type (Maintenance/Traffic/Weather/System), Message, Target (All Drivers/All Passengers/Specific Area), Status, Created, Expires

Update apps/operator-dashboard/src/App.tsx router children array to include all routes: /, /dispatch, /live-map, /active-trips, /drivers, /incidents, /cancellations, /demand-supply, /support-queue, /service-alerts, /fleet, /earnings, /reports, /settings. Import and wire all new page components. Keep existing Fleet, Earnings, Reports, Settings pages accessible

Update apps/operator-dashboard/src/i18n/en.json and sw.json to add keys: nav_live_overview (en: 'Live Overview', sw: 'Muonekano wa Moja kwa Moja'), nav_dispatch (en: 'Dispatch', sw: 'Utumaji'), nav_live_map (en: 'Live Map', sw: 'Ramani ya Moja kwa Moja'), nav_active_trips (en: 'Active Trips', sw: 'Safari Zinazoendelea'), nav_incidents (en: 'Incidents', sw: 'Matukio'), nav_cancellations (en: 'Cancellations', sw: 'Kufutwa'), nav_demand_supply (en: 'Demand & Supply', sw: 'Mahitaji na Ugavi'), nav_support_queue (en: 'Support Queue', sw: 'Foleni ya Msaada'), nav_service_alerts (en: 'Service Alerts', sw: 'Arifa za Huduma'), and corresponding page titles/subtitles

Organize sidebar visually: group operational items (Live Overview → Service Alerts) at top, keep Fleet/Drivers/Earnings/Reports in middle, Settings at bottom footer. Consider adding section dividers in Sidebar.tsx for clarity
acceptance_criteria: Operator dashboard sidebar displays 10 main operational navigation items plus existing Fleet, Drivers, Earnings, Reports, Settings (14 total routes)
All routes are accessible and display the correct page component
Existing pages (Dashboard→Live Overview, Fleet, Drivers, Earnings, Reports, Settings) retain full functionality
New pages (Dispatch, Live Map, Active Trips, Incidents, Cancellations, Demand & Supply, Support Queue, Service Alerts) display with proper title, subtitle, and placeholder content/table structure
Live Map page renders a Leaflet map centered on Dar es Salaam with placeholder markers
Sidebar highlights the active route correctly for all items
i18n works for all navigation labels in both English and Swahili
Sidebar remains scrollable and organized with logical grouping
Tailwind styling remains consistent with existing design
Login and authentication flow remains unchanged
verification: Run: cd apps/operator-dashboard && npm run dev
Open browser to http://localhost:5173 (or assigned port)
Log in with operator credentials
Verify sidebar displays all navigation items in logical groups
Click Live Overview and verify page loads (formerly Dashboard content)
Click Dispatch and verify page displays with title 'Dispatch Center', sections for Available Drivers, Pending Requests, Manual Assignment, Dispatch History
Click Live Map and verify Leaflet map renders centered on Dar es Salaam with zoom controls
Click Active Trips and verify table displays with columns: Trip ID, Driver, Passenger, Pickup, Destination, Status, ETA, Actions
Click Drivers and verify existing Drivers page loads unchanged
Click Incidents and verify page displays with title 'Incidents', table with Incident ID, Trip ID, Type, Severity, Status, Actions
Click Cancellations and verify page displays with title 'Cancellations', table with Trip ID, Cancelled By, Reason, Time, Fare Lost, and placeholder analytics section
Click Demand & Supply and verify page displays with title 'Demand & Supply', placeholder heatmap, Supply vs Demand chart, Driver Availability by Hour, High Demand Zones table
Click Support Queue and verify page displays with title 'Support Queue', table with Ticket ID, Requester, Subject, Priority, Status, Created, Actions
Click Service Alerts and verify page displays with title 'Service Alerts', form to create alert, list of active/past alerts
Click Fleet and verify existing Fleet page loads unchanged
Click Earnings and verify existing Earnings page loads unchanged
Click Reports and verify existing Reports page loads unchanged
Click Settings and verify existing Settings page loads unchanged
Change language (if language switcher exists in Settings) and verify all nav labels translate to Swahili, then back to English
Resize browser window to small height and verify sidebar scrolls smoothly
